verses.verse:
षड्ज पञ्चम भावेन स्थितावन्यौ स्वराविह।
वादि संवादिनौ स्याताम् रागरूप विवर्तकौ।११७।
verses.text: Two other notes standing here in the relation of ṣaḍja and pañcama would be the vādī and saṃvādī, which shape [and set apart] the form of the rāga.

commentary.text: That is, the two notes between which the ṣaḍja-pañcama relation exists are held to be the vādī (principal note) and saṃvādī (consonant second note) of one rāga or another. And by these alone being changed, rāgas with the same notes are also understood as different; for example, in Rāga Bhūpālī Ga and Dha are vādī and saṃvādī, and in Rāga Deśkār Dha is vādī and Ga saṃvādī.
